cues.text: Let's run payroll for the month.
Open HR and Staff, then Payroll. It shows one month at a time.
Press Generate Payslips, then confirm. A payslip is made for every staff member with a salary structure.
Each payslip starts as a draft. Press Approve on one to check and confirm it.
After you pay the salary, press Mark Paid.
Press View to see the full breakdown of the payslip.
Press Download PDF. The file is saved to your Downloads folder, named with the staff name, month and year. The PDF button on each row does the same.
